207:t_018:0.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...I'll be fine, so you... you too...」

207:t_018:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll bring you back... no matter what...」

207:t_018:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Now, let's go, $$千鳥かなめ$$. To our place.」

207:t_018:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll bring you back... to this place...」

207:t_019:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Like hell I'll let you get away!!」

207:t_019:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「You won't be able to pursue us.」

207:t_020:2.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Distortion of the dimensional boundary line confirmed...! At this rate, a $$時空震動|lc$$ will occur!」

207:t_020:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That man... Is he saying he'll cause a $$時空震動|lc$$!」

207:t_020:4.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Then the $$ヘテロダイン$$ from earlier, too...!」

207:t_020:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「So he's the one who called them in!」

207:t_020:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「I simply put it to use, as a by-product of my research.」

207:t_020:7.en:
$$シャア$$
($$ウィスパード$$...! So they really are of the multiverse...)

207:t_020:8.en:
$$レナード$$
「This $$時空震動弾$$ is only a prototype. But it should be able to transfer this entire area, at least.」

207:t_021:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Is he planning to transfer this entire area!」

207:t_021:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But at this rate, the city will...!」

207:t_021:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「There's nothing... that we can do...」

207:t_022:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain! A unit is rapidly approaching this area!」

207:t_022:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「At a time like this...!」

207:t_024:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Our school... and $$第２新東京市$$, too...!」

207:t_024:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain! A unit is rapidly approaching this area!」

207:t_024:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「At a time like this...!」

207:t_025:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's the $$クロノ$$ Reformists' $$アスクレプス$$...!」

207:t_027:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「What's going on!? Hardly any damage is getting through!」

207:t_027:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's an application of the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$. Though it's something only a unit like this $$ベリアル$$ can do.」

207:t_027:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「But that doesn't make it invincible! If I keep attacking, sooner or later...!」

207:t_027:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Can't you see that it's useless...? Or do you just not want to admit it...」

207:t_027:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「Either way, you're a troublesome opponent.」

207:t_100:0.en:
$n
「This is different from $$アマルガム$$'s attacks up to now...! So they mean it this time!」

207:t_100:2.en:
$n
「Let's focus on protecting the school and the city right now, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

207:t_100:3.en:
$n
($$宗介$$... I'm counting on you to look after $$千鳥$$...!)

207:t_101:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it! Tomorrow the third term ends, and they choose this moment to attack!」

207:t_101:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「No way I'll let them do it! We're students of $$陣代高校$$ too!」

207:t_102:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「You've got some nerve laying a hand on our $$第２新東京市$$!」

207:t_102:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Hang in there, everyone at $$陣代高校$$! We'll definitely protect the city and the school!」

207:t_103:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$恭子$$, $$詩織$$, everyone...! I won't let anyone lay a hand on $$陣代高校$$, no matter what!」

207:t_103:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「This Japan still has peace left in it! Anyone who lays a hand on that, I'll crush them all!!」

207:t_104:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$陣代高校$$ is our other alma mater!」

207:t_104:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll protect it! As a Class 2-4 student, and as a Volunteer Club member!」

207:t_105:0.en:
$$宗介$$
(I can tell from my combat experience and instincts so far...)

207:t_105:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(I have no card in hand that works on this opponent... That resisting is pointless...)

207:t_105:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「You just won't give up. Then I'll show her your corpse.」

207:t_105:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「That will break her will to resist as well. And then it will all be over.」

207:t_105:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's useless. You already know that yourself.」
